mainEntity.name: How do I keep AI from mixing up my different businesses or income streams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Separate your business data, prompts, brand voice, offers, audiences, and approval rules for each project. Run My AI Biz explains that reusable prompts can be adapted across niches while keeping brands and audiences distinct. Mixing contexts can produce wrong claims, mismatched offers, or content intended for one audience appearing in another project. Key factors include shared tools, account permissions, source libraries, email lists, analytics, and customer support ownership. Use clear project names and separate folders or workspaces where possible. Require the assistant to state which project context it is using before drafting customer-facing material. Review links, prices, calls to action, and disclosures individually for every project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Keep each project’s audience, offer, brand voice, sources, permissions, and approval rules separate. Use clearly named workspaces or folders, require the assistant to identify the active project, and check links, prices, calls to action, and disclosures before publication.
